definition: Years have at least one application with residual approved rations coded road or freight. Quantities are the unserved balance at the terminal obstacle. Activation is in year 2; the shared untreated first year is included only in the all-years denominator.

first_observed_case.held: Research-only one-year hold of the emergency appropriation. Earlier receipts, cash and opening warehouse and resident stocks are shared. Ordinary policy renewal applies on the observed branch; the hold explicitly breaks the renewal rule.

selection: first seed, then first year; development checked before validation
